{{Quote|Wise One of the Calamarian Seas, you have my solemn promise that I will do everything I can to save you and your valiant species.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], to [[Leviathor]]|<ref name="Glove" />}}
The '''Mission to Calamari''' was a mission undertaken by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in the [[Dac/Legends|Calamari]] oceans to stop the [[Whaladon/Legends|Whaladon]] hunting.

==Background==
{{Quote|Find me the glove of Darth Vader!|[[Trioculus]]|<ref name="Glove" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an unscrupulous [[Whaladon/Legends|Whaladon]] hunter named [[Dunwell]] maintained a massive [[Whaladon Processing Center]] on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] floor of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Calamari]].

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]] proclaimed [[Supreme Slavelord]] [[Trioculus]] as the successor of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. To quiet any remaining doubts about him, Trioculus determined to find the [[Glove of Darth Vader]] and win the support of [[Supreme Prophet]] [[Rajah Ubooki|Kadann]].

==The mission==
{{Quote|Now that we've sent the news to Mon Mothma about the Imperial leader Trioculus, it's time we tried to help the Whaladons.|Admiral Ackbar|<ref name="Glove" />}}
Captain Dunwell, discovered several pieces of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] debris in the [[Valley of the Giant Oysters]] on Calamari, one of which had revealed the outline of a glove when scanned. Trioculus and Hissa immediately set out for Calamari, where they were greeted by Dunwell at his Whaladon Processing Center. In his [[Whaladon-hunting submarine]], Dunwell took Trioculus and Hissa to the site of the wreckage. Secretly followed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] in a [[Mon Calamari submersible|Calamarian minisub]], Trioculus retrieved the glove. When Skywalker and Ackbar's minisub was accidentally captured by one of Dunwell's Whaladon-capturing devices, Luke infiltrated the vessel in an effort to save several captured Whaladons, including the venerable white Whaladon known as [[Leviathor]] before they could be delivered to the processing center. They managed to open the cargo hold allowing all of the captured animals back into the sea. Leviathor herded the other Whaladons back to the Seascape Mountains. R2-D2 activated the ship's self-destruct system and the heroes evacuated the submarine before it detonated. Captain Dunwell died in the explosion and Trioculus and Hissa narrowly escaped.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I shall destroy you, Skywalker! You have my promise!|Trioculus|<ref name="Glove" />}}
To show his gratitude, the intelligent mammal performed a special concert at a Whaladon Song celebration in the Domed City of [[Aquarius]].
